top_signals.title: Bulgaria to Summon Russian Ambassador as Drones Hit More Ships
top_signals.summary: Bulgaria will summon Russia’s ambassador to Sofia after ships were hit overnight in the immediate vicinity of Bulgarian territorial waters, Prime Minister Rumen Radev said.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Mike Bloomberg Opens the 2026 New Economy Forum
top_signals.summary: Michael R. Bloomberg, Founder, Bloomberg L.P. & Bloomberg Philanthropies welcome delegates to the 2026 Bloomberg New Economy Forum in New Delhi. (Source: Bloomberg)
